task.title: Searching for a specific device
task.shortdesc: You use the Who Has service to locate objects by name or object ID (type and instance number).

taskbody.prereq: The Bacnet Device Manager view is open.

step.cmd: Go to the menu bar and select ManagerWho Has.
step.stepresult:
The Search for objects by name or id window opens.
As in the device discover window, you can set device low and high limits, as well as select which BACnet networks (by number) will receive the Who-Has broadcast (or all networks).

step.cmd: Set the Device Low Limit and Device High Limit properties.
In Networks property, select the BACnet network, which you want to receive the Who-Has broadcast (or you can select All Networks), and click OK.
step.stepresult: The system starts a BACnet who-has job. When the job completes, the result displays in the Who Has window.
